properties.name: San Ysidro / Otay Mesa (San Diego)
properties.text: The busiest land crossings. A top fentanyl seizure location; most drugs are hidden in passenger and commercial vehicles.

properties.name: Calexico
properties.text: A California port of entry on the Pacific synthetic-drug corridor.

properties.name: Nogales
properties.text: Arizona's main crossing and a leading fentanyl seizure point, fed from Sinaloa through Sonora.

properties.name: Lukeville / San Luis
properties.text: Arizona crossings in the Yuma and Tucson sectors.

properties.name: El Paso / Ciudad Juárez
properties.text: Contested by the Juárez Cartel/La Línea (designated an FTO in July 2026) and the Sinaloa Cartel.

properties.name: Laredo / Nuevo Laredo
properties.text: The largest US-Mexico cargo crossing. The Cartel del Noreste dominates the Mexican side.

properties.name: Pharr-Hidalgo / Reynosa
properties.text: Gulf Cartel territory in the Rio Grande Valley.

properties.name: Brownsville / Matamoros
properties.text: Gulf Cartel stronghold on the Gulf end of the border.

properties.name: South Florida (maritime and air)
properties.text: Landing zone for the Caribbean cocaine route.

properties.name: Puerto Rico
properties.text: US entry point on the Caribbean route via Hispaniola.

properties.name: Manzanillo
properties.text: Mexico's busiest Pacific port. The DEA names Pacific ports as key entry points for precursors from China and India.

properties.name: Lázaro Cárdenas
properties.text: Michoacán Pacific port. Its hinterland is contested by the CJNG, Los Viagras and Carteles Unidos.

properties.name: Buenaventura
properties.text: Colombia's main Pacific port and a cocaine departure point.

properties.name: Guayaquil
properties.text: Ecuador's main container port, central to the cocaine-export economy.

properties.name: Santos
properties.text: Brazil's largest port. The PCC exports cocaine to Europe from here.

properties.name: Chancay (COSCO)
properties.text: Port majority-owned by China's COSCO, opened Nov 2024. Assessed as a smuggling risk, with US-donated scanners. No confirmed major cocaine seizure is cited here.

properties.name: Balboa / Cristóbal (Panama Canal)
properties.text: Panama's court voided CK Hutchison's concessions in Jan 2026, and COSCO suspended Balboa calls in Mar 2026.

stats.note: Seizures measure enforcement and traffic together. A fall can mean less smuggling, different concealment or different enforcement, so it is not proof of reduced supply.
